title: Patch notes: base walls
subtitle: FANGS Community Edition · 17 October 2026, night
intro: A small follow-up to this evening’s base change: you can now see where your base ends, and the base laser is gone, plus a fix for a rare crash at the main menu.
To get it: start the game through the launcher as usual; it updates itself.

sections.name: General
items: You can see the base border again: like in the old version, a thin white ring marks the edge of each base and a wall of fire stands across its exit, on Embersong, Stormheart and Crownwatch. Once you’ve left your base, that’s where you’re stopped until you die or the round ends.
No more base laser: the turret in each base that shot at enemies (and healed its own team) is gone. Nobody can walk back into their base, so it isn’t needed.
Fixed: a rare crash at the main menu right after starting the game.

outro: Thanks for the quick feedback on the base change!
